lines: It was about a 10-minute walk from the beach.
That's the annex building, the VIP villa.
The Western-style house built in a well-kept garden had the air of an elegant mansion rather than a hotel annex building.
It was no wonder, as it was a special villa where only one group a day, and those being VIPs, could stay.
I think the dining hall is where the medicine is. I'm sorry, but this is as far as I can go...
Not at all, you've been plenty of help.
Ouch... In any case, please take care.
The annex building is heavily guarded.
Well, here we go. We need a plan for how to infiltrate...
To get in while avoiding public notice... But those considerations were again interrupted by Aina's voice.
Huh? Just break the door down.
I mean, we ain't got any time, right!?
It's all the same if we just beat down anyone who gets in the way. Those demons ain't so tough!
Not listening to my calls to stop, Aina had jumped out of the bushes and taken off.
(I can't imagine the guys playing on the beach and the ones guarding the VIP villa are the same!)
But the fact that she had left couldn't be helped. I followed after Aina and broke into a run toward the entrance.
When we busted through the front entrance and tried to cross the lobby, we were stopped by an employee, just as I'd expected.
Excuse me, dear guests. This area is for VIPs only. Do you have your ID?
I remember all the faces of the VIPs. With all due respect, this is my first time seeing your faces...
The general guest building is that way. If you'd like, I can direct you...
Fortunately, thanks to our swimsuit-wearing appearances, we were considered regular customers who'd just lost their way.
Perhaps we could use that misunderstanding to somehow get into the dining hall. We could say we came for a tour or somethingー
The demons came out real quick! Let's do this!!
...Like I said, this is how it goes!! ...Dammit, no choice now!
With things turning out like this, I had no choice but to go with it. "Without much of a fuss" did not appear to be in Aina's vocabulary.
Aina, with her fists, and I, with the vase from the table, readied our weapons and faced off against the demonsー
